snippet.title: Senpai and the Mysterious Island - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/senpai-and-the-mysterious-island/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070600/Senpai_and_the_Mysterious_Island/

An RPG where you get to uncover the secrets of a mysterious island inhabited by succubi that was rumored to contain a lost ancient technology. Play as either the warrior Hula Elstia, or Sonia Lilylantern to a variety of combat styles, and dress them up with various outfits.
